title: Compass and Rivergate
premise: Silas Nakamura chases storms across the Rivergate Delta to outrun a debt owed to the Meridian Syndicate, a lender whose optimism is enforced with violence. When her old rival Odile Voss hires Silas's crew to recover a sealed inheritance from the drowned archive of Halcyon Reach—a site the expedition community swore off after a disaster that killed Silas's father—she accepts because refusing means ruin. The job forces her to confront what her father actually found there: proof that the delta's flood maps were falsified, meaning the coming monsoon will drown thousands who trust the official charts. Silas must decide whether to honor the sworn silence that protects her crew's livelihoods or expose the truth, and in the climax she chooses to broadcast the falsified data as the monsoon makes landfall, sacrificing the payment that would have cleared her debt. In the aftermath, hunted but no longer invisible, she finds belonging not in escape but in the crew and delta towns that stand with her.
about_author: Tamsin Whitlock is a former river surveyor who spent a decade mapping waterways before turning to fiction full-time. She writes adventure novels from a houseboat, drawing on firsthand knowledge of flood country and the people who refuse to leave it.

chapters.title: The Debt of Good Weather
chapters.summary: Silas Nakamura's POV. Her crew chases a storm for hire while she dodges calls from the Meridian Syndicate, establishing her restless rhythm and the debt pressing behind every decision. Emotional beat: the exhaustion of perpetual motion.

chapters.title: Rivergate Rules
chapters.summary: Silas's POV. A portside negotiation goes wrong when Syndicate enforcers corner her; navigator Juno Park covers for her, deepening their bond. Silas realizes the debt has a deadline now. Emotional beat: fear disguised as bravado.

chapters.title: A Name She Buried
chapters.summary: Odile Voss arrives with an offer: salvage the Halcyon Reach archive, the site of the disaster that killed Silas's father and ended their friendship. Silas refuses. Emotional beat: old grief reopened by an old rival's smile.

chapters.title: What Refusal Costs
chapters.summary: Juno's POV. The Syndicate seizes the crew's chase vehicle as collateral, making refusal impossible. Juno confronts Silas about secrets she keeps even from her own team. Emotional beat: betrayal curdling into reluctant loyalty.

chapters.title: Sworn Off Water
chapters.summary: Silas's POV. Flashback woven into present: the Halcyon disaster, her father's last transmission, the oath the surviving expeditioners took. She signs Voss's contract anyway. Emotional beat: guilt signing its own name.

chapters.title: Downstream of Everything
chapters.summary: Engineer Mateo Reyes's POV. The crew rigs their boat for the delta run; banter masks dread. Mateo notices Silas studying her father's old compass, which points wrong near Halcyon. Emotional beat: camaraderie as armor.

chapters.title: The Drowned Archive
chapters.summary: Silas's POV. First approach to Halcyon Reach; the flooded research station looms half-submerged. Equipment fails in ways that feel deliberate—someone else is on the site. Emotional beat: awe braided with dread.

chapters.title: Company in the Deep
chapters.summary: Juno's POV. The crew discovers a rival salvage team already inside, led by a Syndicate man named Corrigan. A tense standoff ends in uneasy truce. Emotional beat: the realization they were never hired alone.

chapters.title: Father's Fathoms
chapters.summary: Silas's POV. Diving the lower vault, Silas finds her father's personal logbook hidden where only she would look. It hints at falsified flood charts—but pages are missing. Emotional beat: a dead man speaking through paper.

chapters.title: Voss's Version
chapters.summary: Odile's POV. We learn Voss's true motive: her family name is tied to the falsified charts, and she wants the evidence destroyed, not found. Emotional beat: ambition rotting into self-preservation.

chapters.title: Monsoon Watch
chapters.summary: Mateo's POV. Weather satellites show the monsoon shifting course—days early, aimed at the delta. The crew debates turning back; Silas pushes forward. Emotional beat: the ticking clock made flesh.

chapters.title: The Missing Pages
chapters.summary: Silas's POV. Reconstructing the logbook, Silas deduces Corrigan holds the missing pages—and that the Syndicate always intended to control the truth, not sell it. Emotional beat: the trap snapping shut.

chapters.title: Rising Water, Falling Trust
chapters.summary: Juno's POV. Corrigan's team sabotages the boat's comms; the crew is stranded at Halcyon as the river begins to swell. Juno demands the whole truth from Silas. Emotional beat: confession as survival.

chapters.title: What the Charts Hid
chapters.summary: Silas's POV. Silas tells the crew everything: the falsified maps, the towns that will flood, her father's death covering it up. Some want to flee; Juno chooses to stay. Emotional beat: the weight of inherited knowledge.

chapters.title: Corrigan's Bargain
chapters.summary: Corrigan's POV. He offers Silas debt forgiveness for the logbook and her silence. For one long night she almost takes it. Emotional beat: temptation wearing a reasonable face.

chapters.title: The Oath, Broken Properly
chapters.summary: Silas's POV. Silas refuses Corrigan and instead breaks the old expedition oath—on her own terms, deciding the oath protected the guilty, not the dead. Emotional beat: grief transmuted into resolve.

chapters.title: Voss Turns
chapters.summary: Odile's POV. Cornered by the Syndicate, Voss betrays the crew's position to buy her own exit, then wavers when she sees the rising river through honest eyes. Emotional beat: cowardice meeting its mirror.

chapters.title: Landfall
chapters.summary: Multiple POVs interwoven. The monsoon hits as the crew fights to reach the relay tower atop Halcyon with the evidence. Corrigan's men pursue through flooding corridors. Emotional beat: chaos sharpening everyone into who they are.

chapters.title: Broadcast
chapters.summary: Silas's POV. At the tower, Silas transmits the falsified-chart evidence to every delta station before the storm kills the signal. Corrigan nearly stops her; Voss, unexpectedly, does not. Emotional beat: the cost paid in full view.

chapters.title: High Water
chapters.summary: Juno's POV. The crew and Voss survive the flood surge together, saving delta townspeople warned by the broadcast. The debt dies with the Syndicate's leverage—exposure ruined its quiet power. Emotional beat: exhausted, hard-won relief.

chapters.title: Compass True
chapters.summary: Silas's POV. Weeks later, investigations begin; Silas faces questions but also gratitude. Her father's compass finally points steady near Halcyon. She stays in Rivergate instead of running. Emotional beat: stillness chosen, not imposed.

chapters.title: The Crew That Stayed
chapters.summary: Ensemble POV. The crew takes a new contract—not to flee, but to rebuild the delta's charts honestly, with Voss in uneasy partnership. Silas belongs somewhere at last. Emotional beat: inheritance reclaimed as future.
